messages:
Jonah: Big personal news: Hannah and I welcomed twins this morning 476476 !! Both healthy and squishy. Wanted to share with the team because youve all been so supportive lately.
Hannah: Thank you all for the love 970 We're home and exhausted but so happy.
Simone: TWO? OMG CONGRATS!!! Sending all the meals and coffee. When can we start the baby casserole schedule? :bento: :coffee:
Tom: Congratulations!! Need a tiny baby tax photo pls. Also can we get an office group card to sign?
Jonah: Photo incoming once the newborn chaos subsides. A group card would mean a lot 60a
PeopleOps: Congrats Jonah & Hannah!!! PeopleOps can coordinate a digital card and a small meal drop-off for up to 2 days. DM me preferred delivery windows and any dietary restrictions.
Hannah: Thanks! Wed appreciate one evening meal delivered next week (no shellfish, vegetarian ok).
Simone: I volunteer to organize a shared card. Drop a message with a short note here and I'll compile.
Tom: Note: If anyone wants to send something physical, please label with "Jonah / Twins" and Reception will hold it.
EmojiBot: Reaction prompt: react with :heart: to send hugs, :cake: to volunteer to bring food, :gift: to contribute to gift card.
Simone: :heart: :cake: I'm in for food.
Jonah: So overwhelmed by everyone's kindness. Thank you. Also PSA: will be on parental leave for 8 weeks starting Monday. Ping Hannah if urgent (she's still doing the holding-babies-and-BSL duties).
PeopleOps: Parental leave noted. Welcome to new parenthood! We'll handle incoming calendar invites.
Tom: Congrats again. When you're back, twin-coded debugging pairs are on me (two babies -> two-hour nap pairing?).
Hannah: Haha appreciated. Also saving two slices of celebratory cake for the office when we're up for visitors.
Simone: We'll hold the cake and a tiny celebration when youre ready. For now rest and enjoy the newborn cuddles.
Jonah: Thank you team. Means a lot. Will post pics when able (tiny faces may be blurred to protect privacy). For now, sending a sleepy selfie.
Hannah: 60a476476
